svg.title: Loup-Garou — Blood and Moon. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Loup-Garou classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 6 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Scent of Blood forks into Run to Ground then The Pack Closes. Hunter's Moon forks into Feral Frenzy then Beast Unchained. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Loup-Garou-classified jutsu (requires classification extension).

Nature's Hunter's 40 EP strike is the kit's only Damage row and stays at base in every legal allocation; its lift comes from The Pack Closes' mark when Life reaver lands first","rationale":"Four supported rows, one per tag, on two single-target cooldown-6 casts. Nature's Hunter (60 AP, Jonin) strikes for 40 EP and gives the caster a 35% Increase Damage Given buff and a 250 HP static Heal tick for the 2 rounds after; Life reaver (40 AP) puts 35% Increase Damage Taken on one target for the 2 rounds after. Neither window acts in its cast round, so the buff never reaches the strike, while the exposure does when Life reaver comes first. The two windows are the kit's leverage: each multiplies every element-less or Taijutsu non-pierce hit in it (the exposure also allies' hits and the strike), and both together cost 100 AP. The tree gives each window one capstone: the mark (The Pack Closes) and the frenzy after the strike (Beast Unchained); the strike itself stays at base. The kit has four supported rows, one per tag, on two casts (Damage, Increase Damage Given and Heal on Nature's Hunter; Increase Damage Taken on Life reaver); the Wolf Companion summon and Life reaver's absorb are unsupported. Two identities hold a route: the mark (Increase Damage Taken, The Pack Closes) and the frenzy (Increase Damage Given, Beast Unchained). Damage is left unamplified (Ha Yanagi precedent): it reaches one row, Nature's Hunter's 40 EP strike (60 AP, cooldown 6; traits \u2014), and at the +2 roster limit a strike capstone (40 \u2192 42, \u00d71.05 on that hit) is under the \u00d71.059 The Pack Closes already gives the same strike when Life reaver lands first, while the mark also lifts every other hit on the target. Its Hidden-Art commit could only be Heal glue, Increase Damage Taken (a twin of Run to Ground that stacks under The Pack Closes), Increase Damage Given (never reaches the strike; with Hunter's Moon and Feral Frenzy a capstone-less build would hold +6% of Beast Unchained's +8%) or +1 Damage, which The Pack Closes would buy as its fourth (41 \u00d7 1.43 \u2248 58.6 against the strike route's best 42 \u00d7 1.39 \u2248 58.4). The Rending Claws \u2192 Killing Bite chain is therefore removed, and a Heal-only capstone (10 HP per tick per point on one row, no Sustain trait) is declined as filler. Universal nodes accepted: with two 3-node chains every 4-BP build holds both Foundations (Scent of Blood, Hunter's Moon), so each route's fourth purchase is fixed and the only other full build is the no-capstone hybrid.","design_notes":["Structure: Scent of Blood (+2% Increase Damage Taken) \u2192 Run to Ground \u2192 The Pack Closes (the mark); Hunter's Moon (+2% Increase Damage Given, +2% Heal) \u2192 Feral Frenzy \u2192 Beast Unchained (the frenzy). Owning both Advanced Arts costs 6 BP. Maxima over every legal allocation: Increase Damage Given +8%, Increase Damage Taken +8%, Heal +2%; no node targets Damage.","2026-10-04 rebalance: the pre-batch Burst route (+5 Damage, Nature's Hunter 40 \u2192 45, Normal to High on the kit's only strike) was cut to +3 and, in the final cleanup (flat Damage \u2264 +2; Heal never the commit before a flat-Damage capstone), removed with its Rending Claws \u2192 Killing Bite chain (narrow-kit exception). The Pack Closes dropped its +3% Increase Damage Given and Beast Unchained its +3% Heal, so Exposure and Frenzy are mirrors; final review trimmed both from +10% to +8% at 2 / 2 / 4 so the capstone stays the payoff: the no-capstone hybrid holds both windows at 39% (\u00d71.39\u00b2 \u2248 \u00d71.93) against each mirror's \u00d71.43 \u00d7 1.37 \u2248 \u00d71.96.","Arithmetic: each live window multiplies a hit by (1 + p/100) in turn and the 15% Taijutsu passive applies last; both rows are element-less, so their Taijutsu filter matches every element-less hit of any stat type plus Taijutsu elemental hits, never pierce. Static Heal is 10 HP per point per tick (2 ticks per cast); the 10% Increase Heal passive adds 10% outside ranked.","Delivery: both casts are single target, range 4, cooldown 6, so each window covers 2 of 6 rounds. Life reaver then Nature's Hunter lands the strike in the exposure; both in one round (100 AP) overlaps the two windows for the next 2 rounds but leaves the strike unexposed.","Allocations: three legal full builds, each holding both Foundations: Exposure (01, 04, 05, 06: Increase Damage Taken 43%, Increase Damage Given 37%), Frenzy (01, 06, 07, 08: 43% / 37% the other way) and the no-capstone hybrid (01, 04, 06, 07: both 39%). Each route's fourth is fixed and adds 2% to the other window, so both full builds reach \u00d71.075 with all windows live (\u00d71.96 against \u00d71.82 at base on a hit under both), under Blood-Enchanted Eyes' \u00d71.234 top package; the hybrid is \u00d71.060. Every build carries Hunter's Moon's +2% Heal (270 HP per tick)."],"risks":["Classification: no kit row carries a non-None element, so the tree requires a classification extension: 'Loup-Garou' is the placeholder name of a new jutsu classification assigned to jutsu records, not a bloodline-id selector; which jutsu carry it is a director/engine decision. All three kit jutsu qualify only through it (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Targeting None instead would reach every non-elemental row in the game. Off-kit coverage is unverified.","Window breadth: Beast Unchained's 43% buff reaches basic attacks, weapons and element-less normal jutsu on every target; The Pack Closes' 43% exposure reaches every qualifying hit on one target from anyone, allies included. Other same-tag effects compound with them. Which mirror is stronger depends on team play and area hits; not simulated.","Targeting: both casts are OTHER_USER. Aimed at an ally, Nature's Hunter's Damage (friendly fire ALL) hits it while buff and Heal still land on the caster, and Life reaver exposes it.","Rank gate: Nature's Hunter is requiredRank JONIN in the snapshot (Life reaver GENIN), so below Jonin only Scent of Blood, Run to Ground and The Pack Closes act; a realized-value restriction, not an item gate.","Unsupported rows: the Wolf Companion summon (marked adverse in the dossier) and Life reaver's 30% absorb receive nothing. Skill-tree and bloodline effects are skipped in ranked PvP / sparring at the pin. No combat simulation was performed."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":6,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":2,"advanced_art_count":2,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":6,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":3,"3":4,"4":3},"full_budget_allocations":3,"non_dominated_full_allocations":3,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":8,"increasedamagetaken":8,"heal":2},"supported_rows_in_kit":4,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":1,"heal":1,"increasedamagegiven":1,"increasedamagetaken":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["heal","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":["damage"],"revision":"Fable proposal \u2014 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Loup-Garou classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed element-wide potency classification; not implemented or verified in the live engine (needs a jutsu-classification resolver).","Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Loup-Garou-classified jutsu (requires classification extension). Off-kit jutsu of the element are in scope by rule; their count is unverified. Original combat elements, recipients and stat/general/element filters stay intact.","Bloodline id, equipment, injected-child provenance and jutsu names are not selectors; equipment only gates castability.","Coverage counts below are this kit's rows only. Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power (EP), not final-damage percentages; every other modifier is shown with %. Percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit."],"ceilings":{"maximum_over_all_legal_allocations":{"increasedamagegiven":8,"increasedamagetaken":8,"heal":2},"ceilings":{"increasedamagegiven":10,"increasedamagetaken":10,"heal":10},"hard_ceilings":{"damage":5,"lifesteal":5,"afterburn":15},"default_ceiling":10,"route_bands":[5,10,15],"routes":[{"advanced_art":"05","name":"The Pack Closes","primary_tag":"increasedamagetaken","path":["01","04","05"],"steps":[2,2,4],"total":8,"on_band":false},{"advanced_art":"08","name":"Beast Unchained","primary_tag":"increasedamagegiven","path":["06","07","08"],"steps":[2,2,4],"total":8,"on_band":false}],"director_exceptions":[]}},"legal_full_budget_builds":[{"ids":["01","04","05","06"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":8,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","04","06","07"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":4,"increasedamagetaken":4,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","06","07","08"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":8,"increasedamagetaken":2,"heal":2}}],"design_review":{"status":"Fable proposal (2026-10-04 batch rebalance); not director-approved","foundation_sentences":{"01":"How do I open the marked quarry to the pack?","06":"How do I unleash the beast in myself?"},"route_identities":{"05":"exposure: one marked target takes more from every attacker, allies and the strike included","08":"sustained amplification: the frenzy after the strike, every own hit on any target"},"director_review":"Roster questions: DQ-B (The Pack Closes +8% Increase Damage Taken on one row, Life reaver 35 \u2192 43%, \u00d71.059); DQ-H (8 \u2192 6 nodes: the Rending Claws \u2192 Killing Bite strike chain is removed and Damage is left unamplified). Tree-specific: confirm the two-route tree, in which both Foundations are in every full build.","concerns":["Damage is unamplified, so a player who wants a harder strike has no route: at the +2 roster limit a strike capstone (Nature's Hunter 40 \u2192 42, \u00d71.05 on one hit per 6 rounds) would sit under the \u00d71.059 The Pack Closes already gives that strike when Life reaver lands first, and the removed route's real pull was the Heal it carried (narrow-kit exception).","Beast Unchained and The Pack Closes are bare one-tag mirrors (+4% capstones, routes +8% on one row each, 35 \u2192 43%, \u00d71.059; \u00d71.075 with each fixed fourth); both full builds carry Hunter's Moon's +2% Heal as their only sustain. \u00d71.059 is the factor of Arashima's Sundered Sky; a rider here would be Heal glue or the other window, which would erase the mirror.","The Pack Closes holds single-row team exposure at +8% (Life reaver 35 \u2192 43% on one target, allies' hits included): \u00d71.059, under Shakunetsu Sakura's \u00d71.075 and Blood-Enchanted Eyes' \u00d71.115, but a primary exposure route at +7% or more is roster question DQ-B.","Both Foundations are universal: with two 3-node chains every full build holds Scent of Blood and Hunter's Moon, so each route's fourth purchase is fixed and the only other full build is the no-capstone hybrid (both windows 39%, \u00d71.060).","The 'Loup-Garou' classification extension and off-kit coverage remain director/engine decisions."]}}

g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Loup-Garou-classified jutsu (requires classification extension). Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 6 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
The Pack Closes path + Hunter's Moon
Beast Unchained path + Scent of Blood
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · HEAL: Heal
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE LOUP-GAROU KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
On a static Heal effect each +1% Heal adds 1 heal power, which heals 10 HP per tick (display conflict under review).
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
3 legal four-skill allocations · 2 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Loup-Garou classification / forked tree
